name: Grindrod Limited
summary: Grindrod Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the logistics services business in the Middle East, Singapore, Asia, the Far East, Australia, South Africa, and Rest of Africa. The company operates through Ports and Terminals; Logistics; Group; Private Equity and Property; and Marine Fuels segments. It engages in the provision of logistics solution for mining, agricultural, new energy commodities and project cargo; import and export solutions; and financing, constructing, rehabilitating, operating, and maintaining the ports.
